content.text: Renaming a clashing variable, re-running the lower tier.
Lintel course needs support-aware segmentation — adding a DP so no brick lands over an opening.
Octagon arcade stands. Now the set-back upper tier with small windows.
The auto-ties stick out badly — removing them and building a proper cornice ledge instead.
rot 90 is being ignored by `put`, so the z-runs landed wrong. Clearing both plate rings and re-laying them rotation-free.
Tying the loose side columns with 2×2 plates at the top, running-bond style.
Found the flaw: my corner ties stacked instead of spanning. Clearing all 2×2 ties to re-lay them correctly.
One structure now — checking the look.
